components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The one Graphite action on a screen or form.
components.css: .ds-btn { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 6px; height: 32px; padding: 0 10px; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 10px; font-family: 'Nunito Variable', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; white-space: nowrap; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1), box-shadow 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1); outline: none; } .ds-btn:active { transform: translateY(1px); } .ds-btn:focus-visible { border-color: var(--ring, oklch(0.708 0 0)); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in oklch, var(--ring, oklch(0.708 0 0)) 50%, transparent); } .ds-btn-primary { background: var(--primary, oklch(0.205 0 0)); color: var(--primary-foreground, oklch(0.985 0 0)); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: color-mix(in oklch, var(--primary, oklch(0.205 0 0)) 80%, transparent); }

components.name: Outline Button
components.description: Secondary actions next to a primary, such as Cancel or Retry.
components.css: .ds-btn-outline { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; height: 32px; padding: 0 10px; border: 1px solid var(--border, oklch(0.922 0 0)); border-radius: 10px; background: var(--background, oklch(1 0 0)); color: var(--foreground, oklch(0.145 0 0)); font-family: 'Nunito Variable', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 150ms; outline: none; } .ds-btn-outline:hover { background: var(--muted, oklch(0.97 0 0)); } .ds-btn-outline:focus-visible { border-color: var(--ring, oklch(0.708 0 0)); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in oklch, var(--ring, oklch(0.708 0 0)) 50%, transparent); }

components.css: .ds-field { display: grid; gap: 6px; font-family: 'Nunito Variable', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-field-label { font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; color: var(--foreground, oklch(0.145 0 0)); } .ds-input-group { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; height: 40px; padding: 0 12px; border: 1px solid var(--input, oklch(0.872 0 0)); border-radius: 14px; background: var(--background, oklch(1 0 0)); color: var(--muted-foreground, oklch(0.556 0 0)); transition: border-color 150ms, box-shadow 150ms; } .ds-input-group:focus-within { border-color: var(--ring, oklch(0.708 0 0)); box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px color-mix(in oklch, var(--ring, oklch(0.708 0 0)) 30%, transparent); } .ds-input { flex: 1; min-width: 0; border: 0; outline: none; background: transparent; font: inherit; font-size: 14px; color: var(--foreground, oklch(0.145 0 0)); }

components.css: .ds-table-wrap { overflow-x: auto; padding: 4px; border: 1px solid var(--border, oklch(0.922 0 0)); border-radius: 18px; background: var(--background, oklch(1 0 0)); font-family: 'Nunito Variable', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-table { width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; font-size: 14px; color: var(--foreground, oklch(0.145 0 0)); text-align: left; } .ds-table th { padding: 12px; font-weight: 500; white-space: nowrap; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border, oklch(0.922 0 0)); } .ds-table td { padding: 6px 12px; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-table tbody tr + tr td { border-top: 1px solid color-mix(in oklch, var(--border, oklch(0.922 0 0)) 60%, transparent); } .ds-table tbody tr:hover { background: color-mix(in oklch, var(--muted, oklch(0.97 0 0)) 30%, transparent); } .ds-table tr.is-selected { background: color-mix(in oklch, var(--primary, oklch(0.205 0 0)) 5%, transparent); } .ds-sort { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; padding: 0; border: 0; background: none; font: inherit; color: inherit; cursor: pointer; } .ds-sort svg { color: var(--primary, oklch(0.205 0 0)); } .ds-sort:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--ring, oklch(0.708 0 0)); border-radius: 4px; }

narrative.overview:
The interface should feel like a well-kept clinic room: calm, uncluttered, nothing calling for attention it hasn't earned. Colour is held back almost entirely, so patient names, vitals, bed status and the next task carry the screen. Staff use it all day; its job is to stay out of the way and be exact.

It is a light, monochrome system by intent. There is no dark mode. Everything runs from paper white through mist and slate to a near-black graphite. Four status colours (red, green, amber, blue) appear only when they carry meaning. The layout is compact: 14px body text, 32px controls, 4px-step spacing. Precision shows in alignment and consistency, not ornament.

Warmth comes from tone, not tinted surfaces. The neutrals stay pure grey. The reassurance is carried by the rounded, friendly Nunito body face, the soft Fraunces serif on titles, generous corners, unhurried spacing, gentle state changes, and plain clinic wording.
keyCharacteristics: Light theme only; achromatic palette; colour appears only to mean something.
Compact, data-first density, built for desktop with tablet and mobile support.
Soft, rounded forms (10px base radius) and hairline separation.
Flat surfaces; shadows only for things that float.
Nunito for the working interface, Fraunces for titles and headings.

rules.name: The Earned Colour Rule
rules.body: Colour means something or it is not used. Graphite marks the primary action; the four status colours mark state. Nothing is coloured for decoration, and status colours are never used as brand accents.

rules.name: The Tint, Not Fill Rule
rules.body: Status colours appear as coloured text or icons on a 10% tint of the same colour (20% on hover), with a 40%-strength border when a border is needed. Solid status fills are avoided.

rules.name: The Never-Colour-Alone Rule
rules.body: Status must also be carried by text, an icon or a shape, because colour by itself fails some staff and some screens. A red border on an invalid field always comes with an error message.

rules.name: The Token-Only Rule
rules.body: Components use the semantic tokens (`border`, `input`, `muted`, `muted-foreground`, `success`…), never raw Tailwind palette classes (`gray-300`, `amber-50`, `bg-white`, `bg-black`). The palette lives in one place.

rules.name: The Two Voices Rule
rules.body: Fraunces speaks for titles and headings; `h1`–`h4` and `font-heading` use it automatically. Nunito does everything else: controls, data, forms and body copy. Never set data, buttons or form labels in Fraunces, and never add a third family.

rules.name: The Small-and-Steady Rule
rules.body: Working text is 14px; 12px is the floor, used for labels only. Keep long readings, such as clinical notes, at 14px or larger. Tables use tabular figures so numbers line up.

rules.name: The Float-Only Shadow Rule
rules.body: If it does not sit above other content, it gets no shadow beyond the resting card. Panels, tables and sections separate with hairlines.

rules.name: The Solid Menu Rule
rules.body: Menus and popovers are opaque Paper White. No frosted glass, no translucent popups and no inverted dark menus.

rules.name: The Soft Veil Rule
rules.body: Busy and error states veil the table with a translucent background and a 1px backdrop blur instead of replacing it, so staff keep their place.

dos: Do use semantic tokens (bg-background, border-border, border-input, bg-muted, text-muted-foreground, text-success, bg-warning/10) for every colour.
Do use status colours as text or icons on a 10% tint of the same colour, and pair them with words or an icon.
Do keep working text at 14px Nunito and controls at 32px. Use 40px rows for navigation and form inputs.
Do set titles and headings in Fraunces through h1–h4 or font-heading.
Do separate surfaces with 1px Hairlines or a one-step tonal change before reaching for a shadow.
Do show loading, empty, error and success states on every data surface, matching the Data Table's treatments.
Do keep focus visible: a soft Focus Grey ring on every interactive element.
donts: Don't add a dark theme, dark: classes or prefers-color-scheme styling. The product is light only.
Don't use raw Tailwind palette colours (gray-*, amber-*, emerald-*, red-*, bg-white, bg-black) in components.
Don't use status colours for decoration or brand accents. Decorative glows use Graphite or Slate Text tints.
Don't fill status actions with solid colour. Use the tinted variants.
Don't introduce another typeface or set controls and data in Fraunces.
Don't mix icon libraries. Use Lucide throughout.
Don't put shadows on panels, tables or page sections, and don't make menus translucent or frosted.
Don't use legacy inventory imagery or wording; the brand mark is the Baby icon.
